notes: Danish State Scholarship is a Danish-government-financed tuition fee waiver (plus living grant in some faculties) awarded automatically as part of the Master's admission application at Aarhus University. No supervising professor or faculty member is attached to the scholarship by design. The listed source URL (https://international.au.dk/education/finance/scholarships) currently returns HTTP 404 (Aarhus University has restructured its international site; the scholarship is still administered through admission/finance pages at international.au.dk). Live research found no professor-level tie on any official AU page.

Government-financed tuition waiver plus monthly stipend awarded by Aalborg University to selected non-EU/EEA master's applicants; all non-EU applicants are considered automatically with no separate application. Official page verified live at https://www.en.aau.dk/education/apply/master/finance-and-fees (the listed URL https://www.en.aau.dk/education/finance/scholarships returns 404). Page states: 'The scholarships are financed by the Danish Government and awarded by Aalborg University. All non-EU applicants are automatically considered when applying to a master's programme.' No supervising professor or faculty member is attached to the scholarship, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

notes: RESDOC (MSCA COFUND, University of Helsinki) publishes an official 'Supervisor pool' on its programme page; the pool spans four themes (infectious diseases and AMR; biodiversity and nature's resilience; secure and sustainable food and water systems; just socio-ecological transition), with roughly 90 named supervisors. Max 3 recorded here, spread across themes. The official University of Helsinki research portal (Pure) profiles do not publish email addresses, so official_email is null per the no-guessing rule.

University of Helsinki University-funded doctoral researcher positions are a university-wide scheme covering all 14 UH doctoral programmes. The official page (https://www.helsinki.fi/en/research/doctoral-school/university-funded-doctoral-researcher-positions) names no supervisors and states: 'If you would like to know more about different doctoral programmes, research plans or supervisors, please contact the doctoral programme directly. Contact details can be found from the webpages of each doctoral programme.' Because no professor is attached to or verified for this scheme itself (supervision is arranged per doctoral programme after recruitment), no supervisor could be verified from official pages.

Aalto University Excellence Scholarship is a merit-based 100% tuition fee waiver applied for within the normal admission process and decided by the degree programme's admission evaluation. Official page verified live: https://www.aalto.fi/en/international-students/scholarships-study-right-started-on-or-after-1-august-2025 ('Aalto University Excellence Scholarships are merit-based and they are granted on a competitive basis to the highest-achieving applicants'). No supervising professor is attached to the scholarship; scholarship queries are handled administratively (tuitionfees@aalto.fi), so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

Tampere University tuition fee scholarship (50%) and early bird offer are merit-based tuition reductions decided within the admission application ('Scholarships are awarded on the basis of academic overall assessment'). Official page verified live: https://www.tuni.fi/en/tau/financial-matters/tuition-fees-and-scholarships. No supervising professor is attached to the scholarship, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.

University of Oulu Early Bird Discount and Tuition Fee Waiver Scholarships are programme-specific tuition reductions awarded on payment timing (first year) and study progress of at least 60 ECTS (from second year). Official page verified live: https://www.oulu.fi/en/apply/how-apply/university-oulu-tuition-fees-and-scholarships-for-international-applicants ('No. The University of Oulu does not offer scholarships that cover 100% of the tuition fee.'). No supervising professor is attached to the scholarship, so supervisor enrichment is not applicable.
